name: Drawing
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of Macau taken from Penha Hill, near the tip of the peninsula, looking east across the Praya Grande towards Guia Hil. The walls on the left encircled the hill of Bom Jesus (site of the former Capela de Bom Jesus), seen also in E.1728-1928.
